title: I made a relaxing constellation typing game with Opus 5.5 in just 2 prompt iterations
author: danjr000
selftext:
I wanted something with the simplicity of Monkeytype, but more relaxing and visually satisfying, so I made Stillwater.

As you type, stars appear and connect into constellations while the site tracks your WPM and accuracy. The idea was to make typing slowly build something visually interesting and satisfying, with a bit more customization as well.

I also added a lightweight live user counter using a Netlify serverless function + Upstash Redis, with anonymous browser IDs and heartbeats/expiration to display the number of active users without requiring accounts.

I designed the concept and experience and used Claude Opus 5.5 on Medium for the implementation. The first iteration generated fake constellations and wasn't quite at the level of detail I wanted, so this is the result after 2 prompt/feedback iterations.

[Link](https://stillwater-typing.netlify.app/)

Curious what you guys think of it.

comments.author: phira
comments.body: Hey that's gorgeous. I found myself wishing I was typing something with more meaning during it, maybe a poem or an affirmation or something rather than just random words. Maybe add a mode for that? super cool love the stars!!

replies.author: danjr000
replies.body: Hey there! Yeah I get that. I generally prefer the random words myself because it helps boost your WPM more over time and helps develop muscle memory for a lot of different words. Yep there is a mode for that! Also a zen mode, type as long as you want then hit shift+enter when you're done. Appreciate you trying it out.

replies.author: phira
replies.body: Appreciate you making it! Ironic really that I’m trying to type \_less\_ these days because no matter how quick I get it’s slower than voice, but I still enjoy the zen of it and being able to continue to type flawlessly while turning to talk to my kid remains a great party trick :)
